_notes: UK 'Where will you be born?' part 2: the pin lands on Slough. Facts are real (Betjeman's 1937 poem 'Slough'; The Office set at Wernham Hogg, Slough; Mars bar first made in Slough in 1932; William Herschel, who discovered Uranus, lived in Slough). Windsor is about two miles from Slough. The banter is opinion.
cap: *bright*, !red!, #swear# (masked in captions, bleeped in the bleeped mix), {TEXT:N} replaces N spoken words.

lines.tts: Spin it.
Manchester? Bring a brolly. Forever.
Brighton? The seagulls will nick your chips.
The Highlands? The midges will eat you alive.
Windsor? Ooh, royalty!
Nah. Two miles up the road.
Slough.
You poor bastard.
Fact one. A famous poet wrote a whole poem begging for Slough to get bombed.
lines.cap: *Fact* *one.* A famous poet wrote a whole poem begging for Slough to get !bombed.!

lines.tts: Come, friendly bombs, and fall on Slough. John Betjeman, nineteen thirty-seven.
And honestly? Fair.
Fact two. The Office was set in Slough.
The most soul-destroying sitcom ever made, and they didn't even need to build a set.
lines.cap: The most *soul-destroying* sitcom ever made, and they didn't even need to build a *set.*

lines.tts: The only sweet thing to ever come out of the place.
